name: Ling
description:
Deals <@ba.kw>Arts damage</>
Can use <@ba.kw>Summons</> in battles

candidates.name: Lantern Lit, Thy Dream Sought
candidates.description: Can use up to 3 summons (max 3 deployed at once). Summons’ effect changes based upon Skill

candidates.name: Lantern Lit, Thy Dream Sought
candidates.description: Can use up to 4 summons (max 3 deployed at once). Summons’ effect changes based upon Skill

candidates.name: Lantern Lit, Thy Dream Sought
candidates.description: Can use up to 5 summons (max 3 deployed at once). Summons’ effect changes based upon Skill

candidates.name: So is Writ, an Ode to Wine
candidates.description: When a summon is defeated/absorbed/retrieved, Ling gains 2 SP and ATK +2% (ATK increase stacks up to 5 times)

candidates.name: So is Writ, an Ode to Wine
candidates.description: When a summon is defeated/absorbed/retrieved, Ling gains 3 <@ba.talpu>(+1)</> SP and ATK +2% (ATK increase stacks up to 5 times)

candidates.name: So is Writ, an Ode to Wine
candidates.description: When a summon is defeated/absorbed/retrieved, Ling gains 3 SP and ATK +3% (ATK increase stacks up to 5 times)

candidates.name: So is Writ, an Ode to Wine
candidates.description: When a summon is defeated/absorbed/retrieved, Ling gains 4 <@ba.talpu>(+1)</> SP and ATK +3% (ATK increase stacks up to 5 times)

<@ba.rem>Immediately gain 1 summon when the skill is activated</>

levels.name: Amidst Pleasant Melodies
levels.description:
Passive: Summons may be deployed on ranged tiles and deal <@ba.vup>Arts damage</>
Active: Ling and her summons deal <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to <@ba.vup>2</> enemies within Attack Range and <$ba.root>Bind</> them for <@ba.vup>{ling_s2_unmovable.duration}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>After the skill ends, retrieve all summons with less than 50% HP. Can store {value} charge(s)</>

levels.name: To Remain Oneself
levels.description:
Passive: Summons may be deployed on melee tiles. If there are other summons within their Attack Range, combines with them into a <@ba.vup>Higher form</>
Active: Ling and her summons gain <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> ATK and <@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</> DEF. Each summon deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Ling's ATK as Arts damage to enemies in the four adjacent tiles every <@ba.vup>{interval}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>After the skill ends, gain 1 summon</>
